mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tightening labor market, which may lead to inflationary pressures and subsequent monetary policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 4.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous contraction in industrial production (INDPRO below 100) and housing starts (HOUST below 1500) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: In instances where INDPRO < 100 and HOUST < 1500, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 275) signals an impending monetary policy tightening, which causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, when CPIAUCSL > 275, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS is above its historical 90th percentile, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1500 thousand units signals weak residential construction, which is a leading indicator of economic contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 1500, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) and low employment growth (PAYEMS < 148000) together indicate a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE > 4.5% and PAYEMS < 148000, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 0.5%, it signals a shift to tighter monetary policy, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances.
